activation: Coordinator /root only after a different actual worker accepts current support/module/schema/test/fixture/docs hashes, including the imported campaign-layout-applicability.mjs helper; immutable codeReview and scopeReview references are required.
fieldFeatures: Complete plain string and source lists only. Structured/table/bubble/unknown types reject. Exact old/current list HTML comparison retains mathematical output and deterministic IDs.
bindings: whole field and every TikZ block
live launcher browser version and current executable bytes before/after validation
browserPolicy: Activation and each synchronous production validation operation query the same actual headless browser launcher. Current executable hash is new evidence; historical executable hash remains unknown. Compare live browser version with both original/current capture versions, matching UA/viewport/DPR and registered font family/style/weight inventory with document.fonts.status loaded. Per-question unused font statuses remain preserved and may differ. No navigation, screenshot or new pixel acceptance follows from this probe.
receiptPolicy: Never rewrite the original receipt or signature. Store originalRendererSignature and currentRendererSignature separately in an explicit addendum. Ordinary receipt verification remains strict by default.
rejection: Any other renderer/source/manifest/parser/style/environment/input/PNG/field/current-stage drift requires fresh diagnosis and relevant actual inspection; this profile grants no unrelated feature acceptance.
